label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y envió a los jóvenes de hijos de Israel, y subieron holocaustos, y sacrificaron sacrificios de pazes a Jehová, toros.
spanish: Y envió a los jóvenes de hijos de Israel, y subieron holocaustos, y sacrificaron sacrificios, pazes, a Jehová, toros.
grammarChanges: Removed the genitive link 'de' between 'sacrificios' and 'pazes' (zebachim / shelamim are both absolute, not construct, so the relation is apposition, not 'of'); changed 'sacrificios de pazes' to 'sacrificios, pazes', matching the unmarked apposition already used for 'toros' at the end of the verse.
readerNote: Chose appositional punctuation ('sacrificios, pazes') over the genitive 'de' because both Hebrew nouns are absolute, not construct; the peace-offering sense and plural are unchanged.
